prompt: Create an original 60 second pastoral acoustic instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: concert harp, flute, viola. Style: rolling harp figures and long woodwind answers. Tempo approximately 64 BPM; D major. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A serene and contemplative piece featuring a plucked string instrument, likely a guzheng or zither, playing a delicate melody, accompanied by a wind instrument, possibly a flute or dizi, providing harmonious counter-melodies. The music evokes a traditional East Asian atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首宁静而沉思的乐曲，以古筝或古琴等弹拨乐器演奏优美旋律，并由笛子或箫等管乐器伴奏，提供和谐的对位旋律。音乐营造出传统的东亚氛围。
